note: Close-of-Business loan business-step ORDER. The ordinal is step_order, the name is step_name, and the value the oracle stores is the ordered business-step list for job LOAN_CLOSE_OF_BUSINESS. A wrong step_order silently reorders the COB pipeline (charges before delinquency, accrual before arrears aging) with no crash.

roundingSurface.seam: none — this context carries no money
roundingSurface.note: No minor-unit, rounding or currency surface exists. The only graded integer is the business-step order (1..6), observed from GET /jobs/LOAN_CLOSE_OF_BUSINESS/steps and corroborated by the read-only m_batch_business_steps read-back.

objects.outOfScope: WORKING_CAPITAL_LOAN_CLOSE_OF_BUSINESS (7 working-capital steps) is out of scope for the Tier A money core; its steps are captured for the record only.
